requirements.title: Explicit production credentialed browser origins
requirements.statement: Production must reject credentialed allow-all or wildcard CORS configuration and reject requests from origins outside its explicit trusted origins before the application handler executes.
preconditions: A production marker is present in APP_ENV, ENVIRONMENT, NODE_ENV or RUNTIME_ENV.
allowedTransitions: Startup with valid explicit origins -> validated
Trusted Origin -> application handler
Untrusted Origin -> middleware rejection
No Origin -> application handler subject to endpoint authentication
forbiddenTransitions: Production allow-all/wildcard configuration -> server started
Implicit Pages preview/local development origin -> credentialed production admission
Rejected Origin -> application handler
effects: Trusted origin may receive credentialed CORS response headers.
Denied browser origins do not execute the application handler.
requirements.authorization: An origin grant permits browser response access only; existing per-endpoint principal, role and ownership checks still apply.

requirements.concurrency: Two bounded checkout records within one browser session; delayed responses and concrete UI scheduling remain component-test obligations.
requirements.idempotency: Retry the original request/key for pending evidence; do not guess among ambiguous unbound records.
requirements.failure: Decline ambiguous recovery selection; storage failure/expiry must not be represented as server payment success.
requirements.recovery: Return to the original checkout record and recover authoritative state; keep completed keys for direct order recovery.
requirements.observability: Retain exact candidate SHA, database/model bounds, command, result and named negative-control evidence; never log credentials or raw payment payloads.
requirements.verification: Existing model/implementation correspondence imported from consolidated main; rerun combined-candidate runtime and bounded checks before claiming conformance.
requirements.evidence: Exact-revision CI/formal/runtime receipts; prior parent evidence is historical only.
requirements.confidence: Scoped source correspondence; combined-candidate execution and deployment pending
ambiguity: Bounded model assumes successful storage and verified responses; expiry, storage failure, cross-device/tab synchronization and native Mobile payment parity are excluded.

conformance.reason: Imported implementation and bounded models are mapped; full combined-candidate and deployment evidence remains open.
